messages:
morgan: quick sync — landing copy pass for launch. need clean, role-specific CTAs for Hosted API / Dedicated / Private. also routing rules for inbound from launch posts + webinar signups.

deepa: +1. can we keep hero lines tight: performance + predictable cost + deployment modes. i drafted short variants.

alex: gotcha. we should align CTAs with funnel stage. for marketing posts -> webinar -> demo/try. for paid acquisition -> free credits > demo.

sam: mockups incoming. prefer 2-line hero with supporting subhead. will show 3 CTA buttons: Try hosted, Request reserved, Book private demo.

julia: webinar gating: capture role (engineer, infra, security). follow-up flows should differ — engineers get quickstart + SDK, infra/security get compliance pack + AM contact.

ben: routing note: we can pipe form submissions to HubSpot with hidden field "mode_intent" (hosted/dedicated/private) and utm_campaign. then workflows -> queue.

morgan: ok, concrete asks: 1) preferred hero copy per mode 2) CTA labels (3 each?) 3) inbound routing matrix for web + webinar 4) launch-post snippets for social/blog that link to correct funnel.

deepa: Draft hero copy options:
- Hosted: "Ship faster with low-latency hosted inference" / sub: "Start with our API and scale without infra ops."
- Dedicated: "Predictable throughput, isolated resources" / sub: "Reserved GPU pools for production SLAs."
- Private: "Inference where you control the stack" / sub: "VPC and on-prem options for regulated workloads."

alex: CTA labels (short):
- Hosted: "Start free" | "View API docs" | "Compare plans"
- Dedicated: "Request capacity" | "See SLAs" | "Cost estimate"
- Private: "Book a meeting" | "Compliance brief" | "Deployment options"

sam: i like those. design note: primary CTA should map to product self-serve for Hosted, form for Dedicated, calendar for Private.

julia: webinar landing routing idea:
- when attendee role=engineer -> send link to hosted quickstart + sign-up for free credits
- role=platform -> send dedicated use cases + capacity questionnaire
- role=security -> send compliance summary + CISO invite

ben: implementable. sample HubSpot mapping snippet:
```
properties: {
  email: form.email,
  mode_intent: form.mode || "hosted",
  role: form.role,
  utm_campaign: form.utm_campaign
}
```
then workflows:
- if mode_intent=hosted -> tag: "hosted-funnel" -> notify growth queue
- if mode_intent=dedicated -> tag: "dedicated-sales" -> SDR queue
- if mode_intent=private -> tag: "private-ps" -> AE + solutions engineer

morgan: perfect. now launch posts — need 3 short variants to A/B test (tone: product-first, economics, reliability). keep copy < 120 chars with link + CTA.

deepa: wrote 3 samples per theme. product-first: "Run state-of-the-art LLMs at scale — hosted, dedicated, or in your VPC. Try the API." economics: "Lower per-token cost with smart batching and caching. Start with free credits." reliability: "SLAs, reserved capacity, and graceful fallbacks to keep apps online. Request capacity."

alex: will run social tests. ask: should social CTAs link to mode landing or to triage form? prefer triage form for Dedicated/Private, hosted goes direct to docs/signup.

morgan: yes — routing rule: by UTM_mode param we decide landing. default -> triage for dedicated/private on launch posts.

sam: design checklist: ensure hero includes 3 CTAs, consistent microcopy for risk/legal links, and inline trust signals (benchmarks + logos). i'll update Figma.

julia: webinar follow-up timeline: immediate email with role-specific asset, day+2 personalized case study, day+7 CTA to book a demo or start free credits.

ben: one caveat: gating webinar form to get role reduces conversion. recommend optional role with progressive profiling through follow-ups.

morgan: noted. action items:
- deepa: finalize hero + 3 post variants (today EOD)
- sam: update Figma + export CTAs (tomorrow)
- ben: HubSpot form mapping + workflows (tomorrow)
- julia: webinar email copy + cadence (day after)
- alex: plan A/B tests and channels (ASAP)

marketing-bot: Reminder set for follow-up: 4987654380 (in 24 hours) :spiral_calendar:

morgan: thanks team — we'll reconvene after first drafts. :rocket:
